nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the WaggleConfig class for reading and writing the user-level configuration file, managing LLM providers, budget settings, model preferences, team server connection, telemetry flags, and embedding provider config.

nodes.name: WaggleConfig
nodes.summary: Singleton-style class that persists Waggle workspace configuration to a JSON file; exposes typed getters/setters for all config fields including model routing, budgets, team server, telemetry, and embedding.

nodes.name: cron-store.ts
nodes.summary: Implements SQLite-backed storage for scheduled cron jobs, execution history, and user notifications, including CRUD for schedules, due-schedule querying, execution recording, history pruning, and notification read/unread management.

nodes.name: CronStore
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed store for cron schedules, execution history records, and in-app notifications with full CRUD, due-schedule polling, history pruning, and unread-count queries.

nodes.name: file-indexer.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the FileIndexer class which indexes local files into the memory FrameStore, computing content hashes for deduplication and building text frames for hybrid search.

nodes.name: FileIndexer
nodes.summary: Indexes files into the SQLite file_index table and FrameStore, supporting add/remove/move operations with SHA-256 content hashing, extension filtering, and text normalization for memory search.

nodes.name: file-store.ts
nodes.summary: Provides multiple FileStore implementations (local filesystem, linked directory, and S3) with a unified interface for read/write/delete/move/list/search, plus a factory function that selects the appropriate backend based on configuration.

nodes.name: LocalFileStore
nodes.summary: Local filesystem FileStore implementation storing workspace files in a managed directory with path-traversal protection via resolveSafe.

nodes.name: LinkedDirStore
nodes.summary: FileStore implementation that reads/writes directly to a user-specified linked directory on disk, filtering out dotfiles and node_modules from listings.

nodes.name: S3FileStore
nodes.summary: AWS S3-backed FileStore implementation using lazy dynamic imports of @aws-sdk/client-s3 for object read, write, delete, list, and move operations under a configurable bucket prefix.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dynamic `import()` of @aws-sdk/client-s3 at call time to avoid bundling S3 SDK unless the S3 backend is actually used.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the @waggle/core package, re-exporting all symbols from the memory substrate (hive-mind-core), config, migration, team-sync, cron-store, vault, telemetry, skill-hashes, memory-import, file-store, file-indexer, optimization-log, and compliance sub-modules.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports 275+ symbols — the widest barrel in the monorepo; consumers typically import from this single path.

nodes.name: memory-import.ts
nodes.summary: Parses ChatGPT and Claude conversation export files and extracts typed knowledge items (decisions, preferences, facts) for bulk import into the Waggle memory substrate.

nodes.name: parseChatGPTExport
nodes.summary: Parses the ChatGPT conversation export JSON format, flattening the node-mapping graph into chronological ConversationMessage arrays.

nodes.name: parseClaudeExport
nodes.summary: Parses the Claude conversation export JSON format, normalising both the old (text/sender) and new (content/role) message schemas.

nodes.name: extractKnowledge
nodes.summary: Applies regex pattern sets (decision, preference, fact) to conversation messages to extract structured knowledge items, deduplicating by normalised sentence key.

nodes.name: processImport
nodes.summary: Top-level import pipeline that dispatches JSON data to the correct parser, runs knowledge extraction, and returns an ImportResult with parsed conversations and extracted knowledge.

nodes.name: migration.ts
nodes.summary: Provides two functions for detecting and performing the one-time migration from the legacy single-mind layout to the multi-mind per-workspace directory structure.

nodes.name: optimization-log.ts
nodes.summary: Implements OptimizationLogStore, a SQLite-backed store for agent self-improvement log entries, supporting insert, recent/workspace queries, stats aggregation, and time-based pruning.

nodes.name: OptimizationLogStore
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed store for optimization/self-improvement events emitted by the evolution subsystem, with CRUD, stats aggregation, and auto-pruning of old entries.

nodes.name: skill-hashes.ts
nodes.summary: Provides SkillHashStore for SQLite-backed tracking of installed skill content hashes, enabling change detection and update notifications when skills on disk differ from the stored baseline.

nodes.name: team-sync.ts
nodes.summary: Implements TeamSync, which pushes local memory frames to a remote Waggle team server and pulls new frames authored by teammates, enabling shared workspace memory across TEAMS-tier users.

nodes.name: TeamSync
nodes.summary: Bidirectional memory frame sync client for TEAMS tier: pushes newly created local frames to the team server API and pulls teammate frames for local ingestion.

nodes.name: telemetry.ts
nodes.summary: Provides TelemetryStore and TelemetryCollector for SQLite-backed opt-in usage telemetry: event recording, periodic batched flush to a remote endpoint, summary aggregation, and auto-pruning of old events.

nodes.name: config.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for WaggleConfig covering constructor defaults, provider set/remove, model preferences, budget settings, team server wiring, telemetry toggle, and embedding config.

nodes.name: cron-store.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for CronStore covering schedule CRUD, due-schedule polling, execution history recording and pruning, and notification read/unread lifecycle.

nodes.name: embedding-provider-quota.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the embedding provider quota system, verifying tier-gated access enforcement and EmbeddingQuotaExceededError behaviour across provider configurations.

nodes.name: file-indexer.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for FileIndexer covering file indexing, deduplication by content hash, remove, move, listAll, and extension filtering logic.

nodes.name: file-store-s3.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the S3FileStore backend, mocking @aws-sdk/client-s3 to verify read, write, delete, list, search, and move operations against a stubbed S3 bucket.

nodes.name: litellm-embedder.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the LiteLLM embedder factory, verifying HTTP batching, error handling, and dimension normalisation behaviour.

nodes.name: memory-import.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the memory-import pipeline covering ChatGPT export parsing, Claude export parsing, knowledge extraction patterns, and the end-to-end processImport function.

nodes.name: migration.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the needsMigration detection and migrateToMultiMind filesystem migration functions.

nodes.name: skill-hashes.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for SkillHashStore covering hash insertion, change detection, and update tracking across multiple skill entries.

nodes.name: structured-tasks.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for the structured task store verifying task lifecycle management including creation, status transitions, and listing.

nodes.name: team-sync.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for TeamSync covering push/pull frame synchronisation against a mocked team server HTTP API and frame conversion helpers.

nodes.name: telemetry.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit tests for TelemetryStore and TelemetryCollector verifying event recording, summary aggregation, flush behaviour, and opt-out gating.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the @waggle/core package, extending the monorepo base tsconfig with composite mode and project references to @waggle/shared and @waggle/hive-mind-core.

nodes.name: vitest.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest configuration for the @waggle/core package, setting the test environment and including all test files under the tests/ directory.
